title: Day 9 Broncos Training Camp Report Defense Dominates, RBs Flash, Dobbins Scare | Orange & Blue Today
text: Full pads went on Monday, and the Broncos defense owned the day. With the offense focused heavily on the run game, there simply wasn’t much room to work — a clear win for a front seven that keeps stacking strong practices. JK Dobbins did get banged up, but Sean Payton says it’s not a serious soft‑tissue injury. Still, anytime your lead back comes up gimpy, it’s worth monitoring. The young RBs? They showed up again — in very different ways: RJ Harvey looked good in space, slipping through creases and showing the burst that makes him dangerous outside. Jonah Coleman delivered the best runs of the day, hammering inside with power and balance. Pads on, and the rookie keeps proving he’s built for this. It was a physical practice, a defensive win, and another day where the young backs flashed their identities. 🔥 In this episode: Defense dominates full‑pad practice JK Dobbins injury update — not serious RJ Harvey shines in space Jonah Coleman delivers the best runs of the day Run‑game focus leads to a tough day for the offense Drop your Broncos take — is this defense truly ascending, and how big of a role will Coleman and Harvey carve out this season.
